title: Ultrasound deep learning nomogram predicts early intussusception recurrence
summary: In 1314 children from three hospitals, DeepLabv3 with ResNet101 segmented lesions on ultrasound (Dice 0.935 training, 0.862 test), and fused radiomics and deep learning features were combined with clinical variables in a nomogram. AUC was 0.892 in internal validation and 0.884 and 0.851 in the two external test sets for recurrence within 48 hours. Authors state prospective validation is needed.
ai_technology: DeepLabv3 with ResNet101 segmentation, deep learning and radiomics features with XGBoost-type classifiers

evidence.tested: Internal validation and two external test sets from different hospitals.
evidence.unknown: Retrospective; no prospective validation; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Deep learning segmented lesions and supplied features to a recurrence risk model.
